Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.90

- Added an optional Renew Tinker's Calm when it runs out setting for long desynthesis runs.
- Interrupted teleports during TT card selling and the Modern Vocation purchase are now retried.
- Unexpected errors now also stop TT card selling and the Modern Vocation purchase.
